name: CoverCraft
assessment: expect a basic customer service assessment
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED.
 Required Experience: Previous customer service, administrative, or related experience preferred, not strictly required.
 Preferred Experience: Bilingual skills are a plus.
 Required Skills:
Strong written and verbal communication
Ability to work independently and manage time in a remote environment
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Comfort learning and navigating multiple computer systems
Reliable high speed internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace
Ability to sit for an entire shift with 20/20 vision or correction to 20/20 (physical requirement stated in posting)
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who wants steady, structured customer service work supporting a real product rather than a subscription or service
Participants who are detail oriented and comfortable with documentation alongside phone and chat work
Anyone who values a strong benefits package and PTO structure over a slightly higher hourly wage
Bilingual candidates, since that's called out as a plus
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need a role without any physical sitting requirements stated as part of the job
Anyone who wants purely phone-based work without email and chat mixed in
Someone looking for a role with built in schedule flexibility, since consistent attendance during scheduled hours is emphasized
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
 Customer service, order management, warranty processing, returns processing, phone and email support, chat support, product fitment, data entry, remote customer service, multi-channel support
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Not detailed in the posting or found in outside research. Confirm directly during the application process.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you helped a customer resolve an issue with an order or return.
How do you stay organized when managing multiple customer requests across phone, email, and chat at once?
Describe your experience learning new computer systems or software quickly.
How do you handle a situation where you need to escalate an issue you can't resolve yourself?
other:
Covercraft is headquartered in Pauls Valley, Oklahoma, which makes this a genuinely local Oklahoma employer rather than a national company just posting a remote listing. Worth highlighting that connection to participants who care about supporting Oklahoma-based companies.
I could not confirm Covercraft's specific felony friendly policy for this role. The posting does confirm they're a drug-free workplace and mentions safety sensitive requirements for other manufacturing roles at the company, though this customer service position appears to be office-based rather than production floor based. Confirm background check specifics directly.
Pay is modest at $17/hr, but the benefits package is genuinely strong for this pay level, full health coverage, a real PTO accrual structure that grows year over year, and both FSA and HSA options. Worth highlighting the total package rather than just the hourly rate when talking with a participant.
Career Pathway: Customer Service Team Member (Level 1) → Customer Service Level 2 → Customer Service Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor → Customer Experience Manager
